_comment: Autonomy dial per stage. mode is one of: 'approve' (agent produces its artifact, pipeline pauses for your y/n before saving; on reject it re-runs with your feedback), 'auto' (agent runs, pipeline continues without asking), or 'manual' (currently behaves like auto). mode governs the human pause for the text-producing stages (investigate, spec, review). The gated stages run a deterministic orchestrator-side check regardless of mode: implement is gated by the product's syntax check; qa (when enabled) by the full E2E suite + acceptance-criteria (AC-N) coverage. For the scraper-debugging use case test and qa are disabled and deploy is not a stage — the pipeline ends after review with a proposed fix on feature/<jobId> for a human to run/verify.
_comment_enabled: Each stage also takes an 'enabled' flag (defaults to true when omitted). Set 'enabled': false to skip that stage entirely — no agent runs, no gate runs, and the dashboard shows the stage as 'skipped'. Skipping is literal: if you disable a stage whose artifact a later stage consumes (e.g. spec, which implement/review read via specs/<id>.md), that later stage fails when the artifact is missing.
_comment_mcp: Optional MCP wiring. 'configPath' points at an MCP-format file in THIS repo (default 'mcp.json') whose ${ENV} placeholders resolve from a gitignored .env (copy .env.example). 'stages' maps a stage to the MCP tool patterns it may call — a stage not listed gets no MCP, so removing this block restores the no-MCP behavior. Servers load with --strict-mcp-config (reproducible; ignores desktop/user/claude.ai connectors). Missing ${ENV} credentials fail fast at startup.
_comment_fetch: Deterministic pre-fetch for `npm run sdlc fetch <uploadJobId>` (and the fetch phase of `debug`). Pulls the upload job's MongoDB document and its matching Sentry events into context/<id>/context.{md,json}. When S3 read creds (S3_REGION/S3_ENDPOINT/S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID/S3_SECRET_ACCESS) are present in .env, it ALSO downloads the job's prod failure artifacts (error screenshot + recording) referenced in the Mongo doc into context/<id>/artifacts/. Requires SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN and MONGODB_URI in .env. sentry.statsPeriod accepts ONLY '', '24h', or '14d' (a Sentry API limitation — '90d' returns HTTP 400).
_comment_reproduce: Runs as an approve-gated `reproduce` STAGE before investigate (offered every run — decline with n to skip; a decline or failed run never blocks the pipeline), capturing the result to context/<id>/reproduce.md which investigate then reads. Also available standalone via `npm run sdlc reproduce <uploadJobId>`. Runs the real scraper HEADED to diagnose or validate a fix. runReproduceCommand builds a SELF-CONTAINED input from the Mongo step (the upload_jobs aggregation) — omitting uploadJob._id so the scraper does NOT re-hydrate — prompts for the portal password (never stored/logged; injected into the input), and sets invoiceFormValues.directInvoiceSubmission=false so a live invoice is NEVER filed (a draft may still be created). NO-MONGO takes THREE cooperating settings: (1) doReproduce strips MONGODB_URI/CACHE_MONGODB_URI from the child env so the scraper's constants.ts leaves its URI undefined and the session cache (session-cache.cache) is null (no unauthorized upsert); (2) SKIP_MONGO=true stops the scraper's own constants.ts from falling back to the SSM mongo_uri param; (3) NODE_ENV=test makes @montopay/base-scraper's base_constants.ts getMongodbUri() return '' instead of hitting SSM (it does NOT honor SKIP_MONGO, so with MONGODB_URI stripped it would otherwise ParameterNotFound-crash at import, before the browser launches). HEADED=true forces a visible browser regardless of NODE_ENV (engine spreads headless:false last). No S3/AWS is touched: setupRecorder/uploadErrorScreenshot early-return because uploadJob (hence uploadJobId) is deleted. See PLAN.md step 7.
